remarks: Welcome to the Hunting Paradise!!!!Escape to your own private sanctuary! This gorgeous versatile acreage offers the perfect blend of timber with a spring fed pond. This piece is located just a few minutes from the famed Genessee River known for its’ incredible trout fishing. This secluded sportsman’s paradise does have electric available at the road,  all oil, gas, mineral and Timber rights are sold with the property!  Dont wait to lock down your piece of earth!!!  76.8 surveyed acres.  Great place to make your own!!!!!
